import json,re,pathlib,collections
d='products/research/starbasedb-test-coverage/'
c=json.load(open(d+'comments-p1.json'))+json.load(open(d+'comments-p2.json'))
out={'total_comments':len(c),'first':c[0]['created_at'],'last':c[-1]['created_at']}
by=collections.Counter((x['user']['type'],x['author_association']) for x in c)
out['by_type_assoc']={str(k):v for k,v in by.items()}
years=collections.Counter(x['created_at'][:7] for x in c)
out['by_month']=dict(sorted(years.items()))
kw={k:0 for k in ['$','/attempt','/claim','/tip','awarded','rewarded','paid','algora','AI','LLM','bot','CLA','CONTRIBUTING']}
for x in c:
  b=x.get('body') or ''
  for k in kw:
    if k.lower() in b.lower() if k not in('AI','LLM','CLA') else re.search(r'\b'+k+r'\b',b): kw[k]+=1
out['keyword_comment_counts']=kw
sel=[]
for x in c:
  b=x.get('body') or ''
  if x['user']['type']=='Bot' or x['author_association'] in('MEMBER','OWNER','COLLABORATOR') or re.search(r'\$\s?\d',b):
    sel.append({'at':x['created_at'],'type':x['user']['type'],'assoc':x['author_association'],'app':(x.get('performed_via_github_app') or {}).get('slug'),'body':b[:1500]})
out['bot_member_or_amount_comments']=sel[:40]
out['selected_count']=len(sel)
p=pathlib.Path('products/services/starbasedb-test-coverage/comment-extract.json');p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=1,ensure_ascii=False))
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False)[:14000])
